name: 30141 · Hiram, GA
findings: ZIP 30141 (Hiram) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (48% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30141 (Hiram) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 12 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.
